result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers define the same three versions and assign them correctly to each placement, with clear space and one-color print advice. A is somewhat stronger on what to drop and simplify for very small sizes, such as a heavier favicon and wider gaps between the books. B is slightly more complete overall: it adds tote production details (thicker hairlines, flattened gradients, heavier name weight, outlined vector files), print safe margins and a quick-reference table, so the volunteer is less likely to need to ask follow-up questions. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers define the same three lockups and assign them correctly to each placement. B goes further on legibility: it recommends a heavier, wider-gap version of the mark for small and one-ink uses, and gives a minimum name size plus a 16 px symbol test. A has a useful quick-reference table and more print-production detail, but its rule for when to stop using the full lockup is less explicit.
